lines.speaker: v
lines.text: [ominously] The Sun just vanished. [short pause] And you have no idea.

lines.speaker: v
lines.text: [curious] Its light takes about eight minutes to reach you... so the sky stays bright. Even its pull on Earth keeps going, for eight more minutes.

lines.speaker: v
lines.text: [urgently] Then, at minute eight... the sky goes black.

lines.speaker: v
lines.text: [ominously] Earth stops circling, and flies off in a straight line into the dark. The Moon goes dark too. It only ever shone with sunlight.

lines.speaker: v
lines.text: [building] Within a week, the whole planet drops below zero Fahrenheit. Within a year... minus one hundred.

lines.speaker: v
lines.text: [urgently] So where do you run? [short pause] Part two, tomorrow. Follow... or freeze.
